sloka: अन्तरिक्षगताः सर्वे सर्वे मायाविशारदाः।सर्वे त्रिदशदर्पघ्नाः सर्वे च रणदुर्जयाः ।। ६.६९.११ ।।
transliteration: antarikṣagatāḥ sarve sarve māyāviśāradāḥ।sarve tridaśadarpaghnāḥ sarve ca raṇadurjayāḥ ।। 6.69.11 ।।

translations.english: All (sons of Ravana) are capable of coursing through the sky, experts in conjuring tricks, capable of crushing the pride of Devatas and all, are fierce in fighting.
